To maximize the total reward in a bandit problem, we must balance exploration (trying unknown arms to estimate their true mean) and exploitation (pulling the arm that has performed best so far). 

Since two of the arms have not been tested, it is statistically optimal to explore them to identify if either holds a higher expected value than the arm currently known to have a mean of -0.5.
